(Currently amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged within a predetermined time period, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor, wherein the escalated alarm is __perceptibly different from the first alarm__.

(Currently amended) A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition and to track acknowledgement status of the alarm; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type, a time that the alarm was triggered, and __escalation status information__; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data.

17. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system.
